editorial.summary: Family-owned Indianapolis contractor founded by Lawrence O. Michaelis and now led by President Richard Michaelis. Best known for disaster restoration, it also does foundation repair, basement waterproofing, crawl space repair and concrete lifting, with 24/7 emergency service.
bestFor: Water damage that also needs waterproofing
Homeowners who want one firm for restoration plus repair
watchOuts: Foundation work is one of many divisions; ask who does the structural work in-house vs. subcontracted
openQuestions: Founding year: BBB says 1982, company materials say 1986
